Bridge visual UI sketching and AI-driven vibe-coding by turning browser-built Material 3 Expressive screens directly into production-ready prompts! 🎨✨

Are you tired of writing endless, verbose prompts trying to get AI coding agents to understand your UI layouts? We have all been there—wasting hours on trial-and-error just to fix misaligned buttons and broken hierarchies. 

M3E Canvas solves the friction between high-level UI design and AI code generation. Instead of guessing text descriptions, you can now visually sketch, link, and layout multi-screen Material 3 Expressive interfaces directly in your browser, translating those visual elements into concise prompts tailored for Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. 🚀

Key Features You Will Love:
🧲 Magnetic connections & layout intelligence: Components fuse together with adaptive corner softening, mapping exact overlaps and rows straight into your AI prompt.
📱 Responsive dual-mode screens: Seamlessly toggle between mobile and desktop formats where navigation bars dynamically adapt into navigation rails.
⚡ Interactive flow prototyping: Define tap-through and swipe navigation paths with built-in transitions to test UX flows right in the browser.
🎨 Comprehensive M3E ecosystem: Access a full suite of components, real shape-morphing loading indicators, and a granular 4-axis theme engine for Color, Shape, Type, and Motion.

Stop fighting with prompt engineering and start shipping clean, production-ready code with zero layout hallucinations. 

Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/lnkiai/m3e-canvas

Stop LLM hallucinations in their tracks by turning deterministic Python tools into the unyielding judge of every AI claim. 🛑🤖

Building with AI coding agents is great until hallucinated APIs, struct layouts, and binary offsets slip into your codebase and cause costly bugs. 

Reverify solves the LLM hallucination and context-drift problem—particularly in high-risk domains like binary reverse engineering and code refactoring—by forcing AI models to propose claims that are checked deterministically against ground-truth artifacts (such as actual binary bytes, execution emulation, or reference behavior) before being accepted as facts.

Here is what makes it a game-changer for your workflow:

⚙️ Deterministic Verification Engine: Uses a pure-Python core (with optional upgrades to Capstone, Unicorn, LIEF, Z3, and angr) to check structural, behavioral, and semantic claims against actual files and memory.
🔌 Model-Agnostic MCP & CLI Integration: Ships as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that seamlessly integrates into AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI, alongside a standard command-line interface.
📊 Information-Weighted Grounding: Goes beyond simple binary validation by weighing claims based on entropy and occurrence frequency and enforcing a minimum information threshold via FActScore-inspired metrics.
🔄 Context Rollover Management: Prevents context rot during long developer sessions by handing off session states to files and starting fresh ones without losing track of progress.

Whether you are automating malware analysis or gating AI-driven refactoring tasks, Reverify ensures that only verified, factual code and data make it into your production pipeline. 🚀

Check out the repo and drop a star to support the project:
https://github.com/2akouwu/reverify

Tired of Tailwind class merging slowing down your UI renders? 🛑

We’ve all been there: combining `clsx` and `tailwind-merge` is a staple in modern frontend development, but doing it thousands of times in deep component trees creates a hidden performance bottleneck. 

Enter `cn` by shadcn-ui—a drop-in replacement that delivers up to a 30x speedup through intelligent call caching and a custom-optimized engine. 🚀

⚡️ What makes it a game-changer:
• Blazing Fast: Achieves a geometric mean of 37x faster performance across real-world open-source repos.
• Argument-Identity Caching: Learns repeated call sequences so render loops can verify by identity and skip redundant processing entirely.
• Zero Dependencies: Framework and runtime-agnostic, running natively in React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, Astro, Node, Bun, Deno, and edge runtimes.
• 100% API Parity: Migrate instantly without rewriting code or changing config files using the simple CLI command: npx shadcn@latest migrate cn.

Whether you are optimizing high-frequency re-renders in design systems or streaming massive SSR pipelines, `cn` slashes class-merging overhead to give you smoother animations and faster page loads. 

Check it out on GitHub and drop it into your stack today:
https://github.com/shadcn-ui/cn

Tired of static prompt wrappers that never actually learn from production? 

Meet Reef: the first open-source infrastructure that shifts AI agents from static systems to self-improving powerhouses through a closed-loop continual learning cycle. 🚀

Most LLM applications hit a ceiling because they can't adapt based on real-world interactions. Reef solves this by providing a comprehensive, open-source continual learning infrastructure specifically tailored for autonomous agents. It connects everything into a cohesive four-step loop: Serve, Observe, Grow, and Commit.

Here is what makes Reef a game-changer for AI Engineers and LLM App Developers:

✨ Dual-Surface Optimization: Supports both model weight updates (using Slime, SGLang, and vLLM) and agent harness optimization (improving prompts, rules, and skills without local GPUs).
🔌 OpenAI- and Anthropic-Compatible Serving: Provides native chat and message endpoints alongside a robust receipt-based feedback reporting mechanism.
📦 Automated Versioned Delivery: Manages artifact lifecycles with built-in Git LFS, candidate evaluation policies, and live hot-swapping of updated weights or skills with zero downtime.
📚 Extensible Recipe Cookbook: Includes specialized recipes (like SAO, OpenClaw-RL, and TTT-Discover) for everything from test-suite verification to reinforcement learning.

Whether you are deploying a coding agent that self-improves its tool-use skills upon failing test cases, or running continuous weight-training pipelines on real user feedback, Reef drops right into your serving stack to automate the entire evolution cycle.

👉 Check out the repo and start closing the loop today:
https://github.com/Human-Agent-Society/reef

Turn any real-world object into a 3D asset in under 60 seconds—straight from your phone into your active Blender viewport! 📸✨

We have all felt the pain of the tedious workflow bottleneck when trying to bring physical objects into 3D modeling software. Building out textures, meshes, and manual background removal kills momentum for indie hackers, AR/VR creators, and game devs. 

Meet camera-to-blender: an open-source project that bridges the gap between physical reality and 3D modeling by automating the entire photo-to-viewport pipeline using generative AI. 

Here is how the stack comes together:
* Mobile-optimized web interface for quick camera capture over HTTPS via ngrok.
* Google Gemini integration for automated background isolation.
* Tripo3D API for high-speed single-image 3D mesh generation.
* FastAPI relay server communicating via a real-time WebSocket bridge.
* A custom Blender Python add-on that hot-reloads and spawns generated 3D models directly into your workspace instantly.

For developers, this repo serves as a fantastic blueprint for building event-driven pipelines that tie external REST APIs, local Uvicorn servers, public tunneling, and internal desktop software automation together seamlessly.

Ready to streamline your prototyping workflow or build your own AI-powered asset pipeline? 

Check out the repository and drop a star on GitHub:
https://github.com/ahujasid/camera-to-blender
